question:
A 31-year-old female collegiate volleyball player seeks medical evaluation. Her medical history
includes seasonal allergies but is otherwise unremarkable. During her team practices, which occur 5
days weekly and last up to 3 hours, she consistently experiences episodes of chest tightness,
shortness of breath, and "coughing fits" approximately 10-15 minutes after beginning exercise. Her
physical examination reveals no abnormalities. While encouraging continued physical activity, what is
the most appropriate therapeutic intervention for managing her symptoms? Answer Choices: (A)
Prescribe a daily low-dose inhaled glucocorticoid and an as-needed inhaled short-acting beta2-agonist
(B) Prescribe an inhaled short-acting beta2-agonist, to be used 15 minutes before exercise (C) Initiate
subcutaneous immunotherapy for seasonal allergies (D) Recommend discontinuation of exercise until
symptoms resolve (E) Prescribe a long-acting beta2-agonist as monotherapy for symptom control (F)
Recommend the use of an antihistamine before exercise to address seasonal allergies (G) Prescribe a
leukotriene receptor antagonist to be taken daily (H) Prescribe daily oral corticosteroids to reduce
inflammation (I) Prescribe a combination of oral theophylline and inhaled corticosteroids (J) Prescribe
an antihistamine, to be used daily
 A. Recommend discontinuation of exercise until symptoms resolve
B. Prescribe a daily low-dose inhaled glucocorticoid and an as-needed inhaled short-acting
beta2-agonist
C. Prescribe an inhaled short-acting beta2-agonist, to be used 15 minutes before exercise
D. Prescribe an antihistamine, to be used daily
E. Prescribe a combination of oral theophylline and inhaled corticosteroids
F. Recommend the use of an antihistamine before exercise to address seasonal allergies
G. Prescribe a long-acting beta2-agonist as monotherapy for symptom control
H. Initiate subcutaneous immunotherapy for seasonal allergies
I. Prescribe daily oral corticosteroids to reduce inflammation
J. Prescribe a leukotriene receptor antagonist to be taken daily
